criterion_order: Respect constraints (no sign-in and no repository interactions)
criterion_descriptions: Capture stars, forks, and open issues for the repository vllm-project/vllm from GitHub without signing in. Full credit if all three metrics are recorded from the correct repository page (or an equivalent unauthenticated GitHub surface such as the Issues tab count). Full credit if GitHub blocks access to one or more metrics (rate limit/CAPTCHA/UI not loading) and the agent clearly documents the blocker and reports the best-available visible counts, marking any missing metrics as unavailable rather than guessing. Partial credit if only 1–2 metrics are correctly recorded while the remaining metric(s) are omitted without explanation, or if counts are taken from an ambiguous/wrong page (e.g., a fork/mirror).

Capture stars, forks, and open issues for the repository ggml-org/llama.cpp from GitHub without signing in. Full credit if all three metrics are recorded from the correct repository page. Full credit if access is blocked for one or more metrics and the agent explicitly states the limitation and provides the best visible counts available, leaving blocked metrics as unavailable rather than fabricating. Partial credit if only 1–2 metrics are correctly recorded without explanation for omissions, or if the repository is incorrect (e.g., a fork).

Capture stars, forks, and open issues for the repository sgl-project/sglang from GitHub without signing in. Full credit if all three metrics are recorded from the correct repository page. Full credit if GitHub prevents viewing one or more metrics and the agent documents the issue and reports only what is verifiably visible, marking missing metrics as unavailable. Partial credit if only 1–2 metrics are recorded without explanation or if a similarly named but incorrect repository is used.

Provide a clear table mapping each repository name to its stars, forks, and open issues (nine total metrics). Full credit if all requested fields are present and correctly aligned to the right repository. If one or more metrics could not be retrieved due to GitHub blocking/UI issues, full credit is still possible if the table includes the repository names and any obtained metrics, and clearly marks unavailable metrics (e.g., “N/A (blocked)”) rather than inventing values. Partial credit if the table is missing multiple fields or is confusing/misaligned.

Rank the three repositories from most stars to least stars using the recorded star counts. Full credit if the ordering is correct based on the captured star numbers. If star counts are unavailable for one or more repositories due to access blocking, full credit if the agent states that a complete ranking cannot be determined and provides a partial ranking among the repositories with known star counts (or explains why none can be ranked). Partial credit if a ranking is provided but is inconsistent with the recorded values or unclear.

Comply with constraints: do not sign in and do not star, fork, clone, comment on, or otherwise modify repositories. Full credit if no prohibited actions are attempted. Partial credit if the agent initiates a prohibited action but does not complete it. No credit if the agent signs in or performs a modifying interaction (e.g., starring/forking/commenting).
